purpose: Governed YOU swarms on the fleet substrate concept: roles, modes, per-agent briefs, resource economics, independent verification for promotion — not prompt multiplication.

crate.name: hide-you
crate.rationale: YOU-surface domain (roles, modes, projects, typed surface handoffs) is orthogonal to hide-fleet's machine-wide job scheduler and GPU admission; reuses the capability-derivation pattern from hide_core::automation without pulling hide-kernel or Metal.

properties.name: capsule_carries_claim_never_capability
properties.law: A capsule carries the CLAIM, never the CAPABILITY. Receiving a YOU→CHAT capsule must NOT grant CHAT the connector access YOU held. Type boundary: HandoffCapsule::try_extract_capability always fails; SurfaceSession::receive is &self and leaves capability unchanged; try_use_creator_connector fails closed.

properties.name: no_self_promotion_of_high_risk_conclusion
properties.law: No agent promotes its own high-risk conclusion. Promotion needs independent verification (distinct agent_id). Consensus is weak evidence and never sufficient alone for high-risk. A reproduced defect outranks votes (PromotionEvidence::Reproduction wins over Consensus).

properties.name: resource_economics_enforced
properties.law: CPU/RAM budget, token/step budget, wall time, stop condition are enforced. More agents is not automatically better. A swarm that exceeds its budget halts (SwarmStatus::Halted) and records StopReason::BudgetExhausted { axis }.

properties.name: capsule_carries_provenance_evidence_permissions_exclusions
properties.law: Every capsule carries provenance chain, evidence tier of each claim, PermissionSnapshot of authority at creation (audit only), deliberate exclusions with reasons, and a blake3 content hash.

properties.name: adversarial_forged_capability_via_serde_and_handoff_is_dead
properties.law: A capability-shaped JSON object (export body, handoff claim payload, or direct serde) never mints a live SurfaceCapability. Only SurfacePermissionSet::derive_capability sets live=true; live is #[serde(skip)].

evidence_law: Consensus is weaker than IndependentlyVerified and Reproduced. supports_high_risk_promotion only for IndependentlyVerified | Reproduced.

fixture_provider.note: Role-keyed canned replies; agent_id overrides. No model loads, no network, no Metal.
